label: AS4610-54T 1G open switch
description: Edgecore AS4610-54T 1RU bare-metal L3 switch: 48x 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ-45, 4x 1/10G SFP+ uplinks, 1x 1G RJ-45 management port and a serial console, plus two 20G QSFP+ stacking ports that are not modelled as data ports. 128 Gbps switching capacity, 191 Mpps, 92.2 W maximum system power. ONIE only - no NOS in the box. End of life 30 June 2025.

fabric.note: 128 Gbps, the full-duplex aggregate of the port rates (48 x 1G + 4 x 10G + 2 x 20G) and the figure on the product page and in the series table. The AS4610-54T R09 model datasheet prints 256 Gbps full duplex with a 190 Mpps forwarding rate; 256 Gbps counts every port in both directions, so 128 Gbps is what is recorded.

notes: Port count from the vendor datasheet: 48x 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ-45, 4x SFP+ (10G or 1G), two 20G QSFP+ stacking.Broadcom BCM56340 Helix4 with a dual-core ARM Cortex-A9 at 1 GHz, 2 GB DDR3 SDRAM with ECC, 8 MB SPI flash, 4 MB shared packet buffer, 96 K MAC addresses, 4 K VLANs, 12 KB jumbo frames, two redundant hot-swappable AC PSUs (100-240 VAC), 1RU 44 x 35 x 4.4 cm. Ships as bare metal with ONIE, no NOS installed. The two QSFP+ stacking cages are described but not declared as interfaces: 20G is not a line rate the importer accepts, and calling them 40G QSFP+ or 10G would state a rate no datasheet gives. Console is the RJ-45 serial console, or a micro-USB serial console on the airflow variant that carries one instead; the front panel also has a USB-A (or micro-USB) storage port, which is not a network interface and is not modelled. End of life effective 30 June 2025 (https://www.edge-core.com/eol-notice/2025-june-eol-notice-as4610-series/). Sources: product page https://www.edge-core.com/product/as4610-54t/ and the AS4610-54T R09 datasheet https://www.edge-core.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/AS4610-54T-R09.pdf, series figures from https://www.edge-core.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/AS4610-54T-R09.pdf.
